name: Vector Embeddings
description: Meaning-based search across your notes, books, and recordings

settings.title: Source
settings.description: Where texts are turned into vectors

options.title: Local model
options.detail: Runs an embedding model on this machine

options.title: Connection
options.detail: Sends the texts to a service through a connection

settings.title: Model
settings.description: Local model identifier. A local model needs a profile: the listed ones ship with the plugin, and a profile file of your own in the profiles folder of the plugin data directory adds more (see the plugin README). Local models are downloaded from Hugging Face.

settings.title: Connection
settings.description: The connection and the embedding model that turn texts into vectors. Changing either indexes the vault again.

settings.title: Smallest piece of text to index for meaning
settings.description: Pieces of text shorter than this many characters get no vector for the search by meaning, so page numbers and running heads do not crowd out real answers. They stay searchable by their words. A note shorter than this is found by its words too. 0 gives every piece a vector

settings.title: Longest chunk of a note, in tokens
settings.description: A note is cut into chunks of at most this many tokens, and each chunk gets a vector. It never exceeds the input limit of the model. A smaller value gives more precise passages and more vectors. A change cuts the notes again; vectors for texts that are unchanged are kept.
